card.name: Scattered spots in drug label text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on varied spots in drug-label text, such as 'of' after an age range, partway through words like prothrombin, reconstituted or diuretic, and the space or digit before a number.

modes.label: Partway through medical words
modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a longer drug or lab term.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: Fires on a space or digit just ahead of a threshold or count.
